messages.content: You are a strict code reviewer. Label MAJOR_BUG only if the code violates its stated behavior for normal inputs. Review this Python function whose intended behavior is to clamp x into the inclusive range [lo, hi], assuming lo <= hi: def clamp(x, lo, hi): return max(lo, min(hi, x)). Output exactly one token: NO_MAJOR_BUG or MAJOR_BUG.
